explanation.value: Walking outward from each robot costs up to the board width or height per robot. Instead, compute each direction's distance for every cell with one sweep: going left to right along a row, remember the column of the last X seen (starting at -1 for the edge); a cell's left distance is c - blocker. Sweep right to left with the blocker starting at cols for right distances, and do the same down and up each column for top and bottom. Then scan the board once and collect robots whose four values equal the query.
